mentions.name: Fiber-routed readable object system
mentions.description: A system that takes in a shape and adds bends and fiber routing so the shape can dynamically display readable objects, inspired by the OptiGap sensor system. It may start with manually placed bending points, with a possible heuristic for good versus bad bend points to be developed before building a UI.
mentions.problem: Unsure whether to add the bending points manually or develop a heuristic for good versus bad bend points before considering the UI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've wanted to build a system that takes in a shape and adds bends and fiber routing so you can dynamically create readable objects.
mentions.author: mrnotcrazy
